notes: I could not run git, so I checked the commit by reading refs. The worktree HEAD is refs/heads/integrate/phase-a, and that ref resolves to 91d36b3ad309deb3350434acaecee0ab2938b13f. This matches the assigned branch and commit.

This was a targeted review, not a full line-by-line read of all 147 files under crates/. I used pattern searches (pub trait, Mutex/RefCell/Cell/RwLock, Cow, PhantomData, Deref, Infallible, Result<_, String>, map_err with format!, unwrap) plus direct reads of the key trait and shared-state sites. Only the first 100 of 147 .rs paths were listed, though the searches covered every file.

RBP-003 and RBP-008: JudgeBackend, EnvSource, KeyringSource, Transport and SessionLog are public traits. Each is documented as intentionally open, which is an explicit seal/open decision. Each is dyn-compatible: &self receivers, no generic methods, no Self in signatures. Transport also has blanket impls for &T and Arc<T>.
RBP-004: semantic ids use validated newtypes (Rev, SessionId, BackendId, RepoRelativePath, Sha256Digest, QuestionId, ChoiceId, ResolvedApiKey). I saw no raw-String id leaks.

RBP-006: the only shared mutation in non-test code is the process-global logger registry (Mutex in OnceLock) in sc-jev-host/src/obs.rs:71-75. It is a correct primitive for the threaded model and the type alias is documented. Other Mutex uses are in test utilities (sc-agent-http test_util, sc-decision-schema test_util, test modules), where Arc<Mutex> is documented as needed because Transport is Send + Sync. No RefCell or Cell appears anywhere.
RBP-007: no Result<_, String> and no map_err(|e| format!) found in src. The unwrap() calls are in doc examples and tests only. No fake-error infallible paths found.
RBP-009: Cow is used in sc-jev-backends/src/backend.rs:116 and :124 (embedded_text), where borrow-first is the right model.
RBP-010: PhantomData appears only in a serde visitor (sc-decision-schema/src/jev/v1.rs:158). No capability-token design is implied elsewhere.
RBP-001: errors use the structured JevError / ErrorCode / ScAgentErrorResponse model, with stable codes and recovery hints. For example, JevError::credential_store_invalid carries a sanitized cause.
RBP-002, RBP-005: no runtime state-machine or wrapper-ergonomics issues surfaced.
